header.title: Deduplication
header.description: Control what happens when a new lead submission matches one that already exists. Off by default — turning this on does not affect leads already captured.

matchBy.label: Match leads by
matchBy.hint: Which identifier counts as a duplicate.

scope.label: Applies to
scope.hint: Check only the lead list being submitted to, a specific set of lead lists, or every lead list in the institute.

options.institute: All lead lists in this institute

audienceLists.label: Lead lists
audienceLists.hint: Duplicates are checked across only the lead lists picked here. Selecting all of them switches this to institute-wide automatically.

action.label: When a duplicate is found
action.hint: Block the submission, or let it through and apply the repeat-lead rules below.

options.roundRobin: Use round-robin, same as new leads

options.resetClosedToNew: Reset to New only if converted or discarded

alsoMatchEmail.label: Also match on email
alsoMatchEmail.hint: An enquiry with a new phone number still counts as a repeat when its email matches an existing lead (e.g. a Google form prefilled with another number).

samePersonByPhone.label: Treat the same phone as the same person
samePersonByPhone.hint: A repeat enquiry with a new email joins the existing lead and keeps its counsellor, instead of becoming a second lead.

blockOwnedManualAdd.label: Stop counsellors adding another counsellor's lead
blockOwnedManualAdd.hint: When a counsellor adds a lead by hand and the phone already belongs to another counsellor's lead, show who owns it and don't add it. Admins can still add.

blockOpenLeadManualAdd.label: Stop counsellors adding a lead that is still open
blockOpenLeadManualAdd.hint: When a counsellor adds a lead by hand and it already exists and is still being worked (not converted or discarded), show a message and don't add it, whoever owns it. A discarded or converted lead can be added again. Admins can still add.

reattempt.title: Reattempt (an existing lead enquires again)
reattempt.hint: What a repeat enquiry leaves behind. Each switch works on its own.

markDuplicate.label: Mark the repeat as Duplicate
markDuplicate.hint: The new enquiry is flagged as a duplicate of the lead it repeats, so it can be told apart and filtered.

duplicateOpenOnly.label: Only while the earlier lead is open
duplicateOpenOnly.hint: A repeat is a duplicate only when the earlier lead is neither converted nor discarded. A repeat of a converted or discarded lead comes in as a new lead.

journeyEntry.label: Add a Reattempt entry to the lead journey
journeyEntry.hint: The original lead's journey shows when and through which source the person enquired again.

notifyOwner.label: Notify the lead's counsellor
notifyOwner.hint: The counsellor who owns the lead gets a Reattempt bell notification (not when they added it themselves).

followUp.label: Open a priority follow-up
followUp.hint: A follow-up due now is opened for the lead's counsellor, and the lead is listed first on the Follow-ups page until it is closed.

showBadge.label: Show a Duplicate badge in lead tables
showBadge.hint: Duplicate enquiries show a Duplicate badge next to the lead name.

duplicatesTabOnly.label: Show duplicates only in Duplicate Leads
duplicatesTabOnly.hint: Duplicate enquiries are listed only on the Duplicate Leads tab. All Leads and the other lead lists show the lead once, with a Duplicate badge. Turn off to keep the lists as they are.

tier.label: Set {{tier}} to
tier.hint: The lead's {{tier}} changes to this when the person enquires again.

toasts.pickLeadList: Pick at least one lead list, or choose a different scope
toasts.pickCounsellor: Pick a counsellor, or choose a different repeat-lead counsellor option
